sam: Repro: Retrofit 2.9 + OkHttp 4.11 on Android 11 emulator. When a long streaming GET hits 401 we see two refresh hits and then stream closed.
lee: Are you using OkHttp Authenticator? It can run concurrently. Interceptor attaches token earlier.
sam: Yes Authenticator. We used a synchronized block but still saw parallel /auth/refresh calls.
anya: Emulator socket resets can cause OkHttp to retry; try `retryOnConnectionFailure(false)` and add singleflight for refresh.
sam: Tried retryOff, still happened. Switching to interceptor avoided duplicate refreshes but we need 401-triggered refresh for some flows.
lee: For streams, Authenticator returning null prevents retry. Also make refresh idempotent and guard with a global mutex.
anya: Good candidate for a quickstart doc note: "Streaming endpoints + auth: prefer interceptor or guard refresh with singleflight; consider returning null from Authenticator for non-replayable requests."
ci-bot: build/sampleapp-android #498 passed  artifact://sampleapp/1961000000/repro.apk
sam: Filing a tiny README PR with repro steps + test apk. Thanks! :thumbsup:
